nuggets.text: Spartans coach Michael Vick was the No. 1 overall pick in the 2001 NFL Draft, by the Atlanta Falcons.
Spartans coach Michael Vick went 22-2 as Virginia Tech's starting quarterback and led the Hokies to a national title game.
Michael Vick's work building the Spartans became a BET docu-series, 'The Coach Vick Experience.'
The Spartans opened 2026 with a 56-0 rout of Winston-Salem State, their first shutout since 2019.
Against Winston-Salem State, the Spartans went 8-for-8 in the red zone with five different rushing touchdown scorers.
The Spartans' road game at Old Dominion last week was played about 4.3 miles from their own Norfolk campus.
Norfolk State's Spartan Legion band traces to William Swaringer, who played solo when no one joined his pep band.
Norfolk State's Spartan Legion band marched in the 2023 Rose Parade, selected on the school's first application.
Friday is the first-ever football meeting between the Spartans and the Virginia Cavaliers.
The Spartans lead rival Hampton 30-29-1 in the Battle of the Bay, which resumes next week in Norfolk.
